name: Average Costing Warehouse
description:
The Warehouse Wise Average Costing app in Odoo simplifies the process of managing product costs across multiple warehouses. It enables businesses to calculate and track average product costs separately for each warehouse, ensuring accurate inventory valuation and cost management.

        Key Features:
        1) Warehouse-Wise Average Costing:
           - Automatically calculates and tracks the average cost of products for each warehouse.

        2) Inventory Valuation Per Warehouse:
           - View inventory valuation separately for each warehouse, ensuring accurate cost tracking.

        3) Warehouse-Specific Costing Table:
           - Access a detailed costing table in the product form that displays costs per warehouse.

        4) Landed Cost in Internal Transfers:
           - Account for landed costs during internal stock transfers between warehouses.

        5) Warehouse Selection in Revaluation:
           - Select specific warehouses for product revaluation, ensuring accurate adjustments.

        6) Warehouse-Based Purchase Tracking:
           - Track and manage purchase costs by warehouse for better cost control.

        Use Cases:
        - Track and manage product pricing separately for each warehouse, ensuring accurate costing across multiple locations.
        - Manage purchases and internal transfers with accurate warehouse-specific costing.
        - Perform product revaluation by warehouse for precise inventory valuation and cost updates.

        This app is ideal for businesses with multiple warehouses who need to track product costs and valuations accurately for each location.

name: Category Multiple Website
description: This powerful Odoo module enhances your store’s flexibility by allowing you to assign multiple websites to a single product category. By default, Odoo only supports linking a category to one website, but with this module, you can easily display specific categories on selected websites according to your needs. It also includes a mass update feature that enables you to quickly update website assignments for multiple categories at once, saving time and improving productivity. Ideal for businesses managing multiple online stores, this module streamlines category management, enhances control over category visibility, and helps improve your website’s organization and SEO performance.

The module provides a centralized interface to create, configure, and personalize websites individually. It also supports separate social media profiles and analytics tools for each website. Users can create websites directly from the settings menu and view or manage them through a dedicated kanban interface with quick access buttons. Ideal for businesses that operate different brands or regions under a single system.

name: Barcode in reports
description:
The Print Barcode In Reports module enables users to display product barcodes in various Odoo reports such as sales orders, purchase orders, delivery slips, invoices, and vendor bills. This helps streamline business operations by allowing barcode scanners to quickly read product and transaction data directly from printed documents.

Key Features:
- Print barcodes in sales reports including quotations, sale orders, and pro-forma invoices.
- Print barcodes in purchase reports including RFQs and purchase orders.
- Display barcodes in inventory reports like delivery slips.
- Include barcodes in accounting documents such as customer invoices and vendor bills.
- Customize barcode types and configure height and width.
